seoTitle: Bulk Title Truncation Preview from CSV
metaDescription: Check many titles at once for estimated pixel width and where desktop and mobile results would cut them off. Free, private.
intro: Shows an estimated width and cut-off point for each title in a list or CSV.
why:
Checking titles one by one is slow. Paste hundreds, see which would be cut and where the text after the cut falls.

Widths are estimated from Arial-like metrics at 20px, and the desktop and mobile limits are adjustable estimates. Search engines use their own fonts and often rewrite titles, so this is a guide. Edit the list and run again to test rewrites.
howTo: Paste titles one per line, or a CSV with a title column.
Adjust the pixel limits if you want.
Edit the long titles and re-run.

faq.a: Approximate. They come from font metrics, not a real search page.
Desktop and mobile results truncate differently.
Copy the table; the preview column shows the cut.
